name: speakhub
description: SpeakHub — offline English speaking club: booking, payment, placement and progress assessment, teacher and admin tooling.

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import{readdirSync,statSync}from'node:fs';import{join}from'node:path';import{execFileSync}from'node:child_process';const w=d=>readdirSync(d).flatMap(e=>{const p=join(d,e);return statSync(p).isDirectory()?w(p):p.endsWith('.js')?[p]:[]});for(const f of [...w('api'),...w('lib')])execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('syntax ok')"
